requirement.normalizedRequirement: The submersion factor k_2 is determined as follows: k_2 = 0.8 - f when f < 0; k_2 = 0.8 - 0.4*f when 0 <= f <= 1; k_2 = 0.6 - 0.2*f when 1 < f <= 2.5; and k_2 = 0.1 when f > 2.5 (6.15). The immersion function is f = (h_0 - H_ice)/(D/2) - 1 (6.16).
requirement.source: Ice Class Regulations and the Application Thereof
